Tooling for building various things related to Ansible

Scripts that are here:

* antsibull-build - Builds Ansible 6+ from component collections ([docs](https://github.com/ansible-community/antsibull/blob/main/docs/build-ansible.rst))

Related projects are [antsibull-changelog](https://pypi.org/project/antsibull-changelog/) and [antsibull-docs](https://pypi.org/proje

commits.message:
Move source subdir (#24)

* Use poetry-core as the build backend.

poetry has been split into poetry and poetry-core.  The core is a small
subset of functionality that is what is necessary to build python
packages.  Changing from poetry to poetry-core should improve the
`pip install antsibull`
commits.author: Toshio Kuratomi

commits.message: Allow collections to have extra documentation next to the generated plugin docs.
commits.author: Felix Fontein

commits.message: Replace 3.0 with 3 in one more place (#269)
commits.author: Toshio Kuratomi

commits.message: Support object (role, playbook) announcements in combined changelog.
commits.author: Felix Fontein
